newsitem.headline: TABLE - Travelers Group Inc Q2 oper net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTES: Q2 1997 oper net excludes portfolio gains $5.7 million, $0.01 per share. Q2 1996 excludes portfolio losses $58.8 million, $0.08 per share.
Q2 1996 oper net excludes gain on sale of units and affiliates $388.9 million, $0.61 per share, and charge for increase in reserves $320.6 million, $0.51 per share.
Q2 net income $662.9 million or $1.00 per share versus $575.7 million or $0.88 per share.
NOTES: Six-month 1997 oper net excludes portfolio gains $14.8 million, $0.02 per share. Six-month 1996 excludes portfolio losses $18.2 million, $0.03 per share.
Six month 1996 oper net excludes gain on sale of units and affiliates $388.9 million, $0.61 per share, and charge for increase in reserves $320.6 million, $0.50 per share.
Six-month net income $1.31 billion or $1.96 per share versus $1.10 billion or $1.65 per share.
